nodes.name: Build Manual Batch
nodes.notes: Demo: every bundled contact. HubSpot mode: MANUAL_TEST_CONTACT_IDS.

nodes.name: Validate Intake
nodes.notes: Checks the shared secret in constant time and extracts contact IDs. Never echoes the payload.

nodes.name: Raise If Misconfigured
nodes.notes: Turns a 503 "not configured" reply into a failed execution, so the error branch alerts.

nodes.name: Load Config & Route
nodes.notes: Validates configuration and pins one clock for the whole run.

nodes.name: Run Demo Normalization
nodes.notes: Bundled fictional contacts, mock HubSpot, mock line types. No network.

nodes.name: Enforce Sandbox & Plan Contact Reads
nodes.notes: Stops unless the portal is a sandbox or developer test account (SANDBOX_MODE=true).

nodes.name: HubSpot: Get Contact
nodes.notes: Continues on error: an unreadable contact is reported, the rest of the batch proceeds.

nodes.name: Plan Carrier Lookups
nodes.notes: Cache, de-duplication, fictional-number skip and the daily budget (workflow static data).

nodes.name: Twilio: Line Type Lookup
nodes.notes: Twilio Lookup v2 line_type_intelligence. Credentials come from $env at request time. A failure becomes line type "unknown".

nodes.name: Decide Property Updates
nodes.notes: Pure decision: E.164 values, line types, eligibility, best numbers and the property diff.

nodes.name: Plan HubSpot Writes
nodes.notes: Outputs PATCH requests only when DRY_RUN=false and something changed.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Update Contact
nodes.notes: PATCH /crm/v3/objects/contacts/{id}. Failed updates are counted and fail the run at Finalize.

nodes.name: Record Audit Metrics
nodes.notes: Masked audit event plus 30 days of daily counters in workflow static data.

nodes.name: Finalize Run
nodes.notes: Fails the execution when any HubSpot update failed, so the error branch alerts.

nodes.name: Build Redacted Alert
nodes.notes: Redacts tokens, Twilio SIDs, webhook URLs and phone numbers before alerting.

parameters.content:
## Phone normalizer: safety defaults
- **Demo mode** while HUBSPOT_PRIVATE_APP_TOKEN is a placeholder: bundled fictional contacts, no network.
- **DRY_RUN=true**: reads and decides, never writes to HubSpot.
- **SANDBOX_MODE=true**: refuses production portals.
- **LOOKUP_PROVIDER=mock**: simulated line types, no paid lookups. Not allowed for live writes.
- Daily lookup budget, 90-day lookup cache, fictional numbers never sent to the carrier.
- Logs and audit events carry masked numbers only; alerts are redacted.
